name: The first reference URL is a valid reachable web address
description: The first URL shown in the References section should be a real, non-broken link that starts with https:// and points to a real domain (not localhost or placeholder).

planSteps.description: Click on any bracket cell to open a match detail page

Verify the first reference URL is a valid web address starting with https:// and pointing to a recognizable domain (e.g., fifa.com, bbc.com, goal.com, transfermarkt.com, or any real news/sports site). URLs like https://example.com, http://localhost, or placeholder text are not acceptable.
